_comment: Every hook this repo arms, by id. settings.json calls run-hook.mjs <id>; this file says what the id is, which script backs it, what it does, which strictness profiles it belongs to, and the fingerprint of the script as reviewed. Adapted from ECC's hooks.metadata.json. Profiles: `off` arms nothing, `standard` is the day-to-day gate set, `strict` adds the harness-freeze rules. Set SPECKIT_HOOK_PROFILE, or SPECKIT_DISABLED_HOOKS=id,id to silence one gate; SPECKIT_HOOKS_DRY_RUN=1 downgrades every block to a report. `fail_closed: true` marks a gate whose refusal is a safety guarantee: run-hook.mjs refuses on its behalf (exit 2) when the payload arrives truncated or unparseable, instead of the silent exit 0 that a gate's own `catch` used to produce. Fingerprints are checked by `node scripts/doctor.mjs` and refreshed with `--bless-hooks` — a mismatch means a gate's own script changed, which is the edit a weakened gate always needs.

helpers.description: Conventional-Commit message policy; run by the pre-commit gate, not wired to an event of its own

hooks.description: Re-anchor a new session: branch and feature state, the mode context for where the feature stands, earned instincts, and the check commands — inside a character budget

On the main checkout, when two or more worktrees hold live or in-flight work (watch.mjs --json, read-only, under a timeout), and no live watch.mjs --wait holds the repository, print one line telling the session to arm the wait; silent otherwise, and always exits 0

Pin gh to the george-hutanu account for the session (GH_TOKEN via CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, resolved per command, never written out) and report when git author, committer or credential pinning has drifted from george-hutanu <hutanugeorge40@gmail.com>
Block history-destroying git (force-push, reset --hard, clean -f) and deletion of .work/
Gate `git commit` on message policy and spec-drift — not traceability (retired) and not the test suite (.husky/pre-commit runs it)
Constitution VII: refuse `gh pr merge` (and the REST merge call) while the PR's head commit has no `agent-review` success from the PR tester

Route a reviewer subagent to sonnet or fable from the size of the diff it is about to read — mechanical at both extremes, jev in the middle band. Advisory: it rewrites the model or does nothing, and can never refuse a call
Protect the ratchets: the mutation floor, the traceability baseline, the NNN-FR- tokens in tests, and (under strict) the harness itself
Block src/ and bin/ edits on a feature branch until tests/ carry that feature's NNN-FR- tokens
Syntax-check the edited file and run the tests affected by it
Refuse to end a session whose uncommitted code changes leave npm test + lint red

Constitution VII: refuse to end a session on a task branch with unpushed commits, with no PR, with a green ready PR the PR tester has not passed (no `agent-review` on its head, unless it was handed off to a tail agent), or with a ready PR whose checks and agent review passed but that is not merged
Record per-session skill, subagent, tool and token usage under .specify/telemetry/ (counts only, never content)
Append branch, HEAD, task counts and the dirty tree to auto-run.md before context is summarised
Reject a reviewer subagent report that carries no VERDICT: line
